overview: Returns questions take patience and a careful reading of policy. We set up a helper that asks the customer a few simple questions, such as order date, item and reason, then explains whether they can return it, how to send it back and what happens next. It follows your written policy exactly and passes exceptions, damaged goods and large refunds to a person.

faq: No. It explains the policy and collects the details, and your team issues the refund. We can add an approval step so staff decide in one click, but money never moves on its own.
What if my policy is unclear?
We read it with you and point out gaps, then suggest clearer wording before building. A helper can only be as consistent as the policy behind it.
Anything outside your rules, such as late returns, damaged goods or high value orders, is passed to a person with the order and the customer message attached.
Does it work with return apps like Loop or Returnly?
We can point customers to them and mirror their rules. Deeper connections depend on what the app allows, so tell us which one you use and we confirm first.
